files.image: same immutable PostgreSQL Bookworm image; PostgreSQL is not started

corrections: Hold the exported PostgreSQL snapshot with the actual background psql PID; stop and wait for that PID on success and failure.
Hash each selected PostgreSQL row before sorted digest aggregation; bound selected rows and total user-table schema inventory.
Use stable selected Redis string GET-byte digests rather than encoding-dependent DUMP serialization; compare absolute expiration times.
Accept missing TypeMeta only inside correctly typed Kubernetes lists; reject explicit mismatches.
Normalize absent readOnly to false only for persistentVolumeClaim.readOnly and container.volumeMounts[].readOnly.

Compare manual-record identities by all six fields and reject a null ledger identity. Existing input/view builders already normalized field order, so the former comparison bug was not reproduced here.
Bounded FileHandle writes replace a pipeline that previously waited indefinitely for a disabled auto-close event.
boundaries: Operator-reported backup/restore metadata never claims platform verification.
The copy receipt proves bytes and the original manifest digest, not the physical disaster-recovery location of an operator label.
Targets must use a new Service, Volume and PVC created after backup completion; source and failed targets are retained.
A successful import produces restore-prepared.json with result incomplete; formal workload verification is required for restore-complete.json.
Helpers and maintenance are fenced by original identities; success/failure never automatically resumes a Service, exits maintenance or switches traffic.
Artifacts are bounded to 1 GiB. PostgreSQL proof markers are 1–32 tables, at most 10000 rows each and at most 256 user tables.
Redis proof markers are 1–32 selected string or absent keys in one DB, with value digest and absolute TTL; RDB still contains all databases/types.
Files support ordinary files/directories and POSIX numeric ownership/mode; links/devices/extensions/special bits are rejected, ACL/xattr/SELinux/sparse layouts are not preserved.
Local protocol tests require openssl, Python 3 and Bash; real database executables were not installed or run.
